candidate.note: v0.6.9 follow-up to 0.6.8: Codex clamps SessionEnd hook timeouts to 3 s and warned about the 10 s value (#112). hooks.json entry → timeout 3, lifecycle inventory, contract tests, docs, changelog, version bump. Fifteen gates; fourteen passed on the first attempt, package-runtime-e2e passed on an immediate re-run after a transient embeddings-stage failure (see gate entry).

gates.name: tests
gates.observed: 119 files / 1251 Vitest tests passed (hook-contract tests now pin timeout 3 on the SessionEnd export entry).

gates.name: package-runtime-e2e
gates.observed: FAILED on the first attempt — `memex backfill all` in the packaged install aborted at the embeddings stage right after "Loading embedding model Xenova/multilingual-e5-small" (the CLI prints only "embeddings backfill failed", the underlying error is not surfaced; the packaged e2e does not pin MEMEX_MODEL_CACHE_DIR, so the model is fetched into the temporary data root on every run — a network-dependent step). Re-run alone immediately afterwards: PASS, memex-0.6.9.tgz, 332 files, 9 MCP tools. Recorded as a retry, not a first-attempt pass; follow-up filed as #113.
